newsitem.title: USA: Mount Laurel, N.J., weighs school cuts -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Mount Laurel, N.J., weighs school cuts -- paper.

text.p: Mount Laurel, N.J., education officials are weighing how to comply with an order to cut $417,000 from the school district budget, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Tuesday.
The Township council ordered the cuts after voters rejected a $36 million budget and a $28 million bond issue on April 15.

The recommended budget cuts included reductions in the number of new teachers hired to deal with the district's growing student body, as well as capital fund balances from prior years, the newspaper said.
